items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: I would say that he had a tremendous influence on me.

ctx.x: Right. He wasn't a flashy young man, but he had a great left hand.

Did you know him personally? Not personally, but I heard him a couple of times and he was very good. Very good. I knew some people that told me who he was, you know. But he never did play too much. I think he got sick or something, didn't he? Yeah. Because I never did hear too much of him. But he was good. And of course you had the other piano players that had the great impact like Fats Waller, you know, came along with his style of playing. Did he ever come down here?
